name: rectangularRep
doc:
**任意 `m × n` 层的精确双向表示**：`compile := layerOfListRect`，`extract := listOfLayerRect`。

`roundtrip` 用的是 `roundtrip_rect`，不是假设。
stmt:
noncomputable def rectangularRep (hn : 0 < n) :
    Representation { s : List ℝ // s.length = m * n + n } (LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)) where
  inputP
proof:
Fin n → ℝ
  inputW := Fin n → ℝ
  encode := id
  decode := id
  compile := fun p => layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) p.val
  extract := fun L => ⟨listOfLayerRect hn L, listOfLayerRect_length hn L⟩
  roundtrip := by
    intro p
    apply Subtype.ext
    exact roundtrip_rect hn p.val p.property

name: rectangularRep_roundtrip
doc: **往返**：提取是编译的逆。
stmt:
theorem rectangularRep_roundtrip (hn : 0 < n)
    (p : { s : List ℝ // s.length = m * n + n }) :
    (rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).extract
        ((rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).compile p) = p

name: rectangularRep_val_roundtrip
doc: **读回的值就是原来的列表**。
stmt:
theorem rectangularRep_val_roundtrip (hn : 0 < n) (s : List ℝ)
    (hlen : s.length = m * n + n) :
    ((rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).extract
        ((rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).compile ⟨s, hlen⟩)).val = s

name: rectangularRep_coeff
doc:
**读回系数**：逆读出的第 `i*n + j` 项就是编译进去的 `W i j`。

这条把「提取」与权重矩阵的**分量**连起来，而不只是说两个列表相等。
stmt:
theorem rectangularRep_coeff (hn : 0 < n) (s : List ℝ) (hlen : s.length = m * n + n)
    (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
    ((rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).extract
        ((rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).compile ⟨s, hlen⟩)).val.getD
        (i.val * n + j.val) 0 =
      (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).W i j
proof:
by
  rw [rectangularRep_val_roundtrip]
  exact (layerOfListRect_W s i j).symm

name: rectangularRep_bias
doc: **读回偏置**：第 `m*n + j` 项就是 `b j`。
stmt:
theorem rectangularRep_bias (hn : 0 < n) (s : List ℝ) (hlen : s.length = m * n + n)
    (j : Fin n) :
    ((rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).extract
        ((rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn).compile ⟨s, hlen⟩)).val.getD
        (m * n + j.val) 0 =
      (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).b j

name: rectangularRep_degenerates
doc:
**`m = n` 时退化为方阵版**：两个 `Representation` 的 `compile` 逐字相同。

这是「推广而非平行」的机器检查形式：方阵版不是被取代，而是本节的一个特例。
stmt:
theorem rectangularRep_degenerates (h : 0 < n) (s : List ℝ)
    (hlen : s.length = n * n + n) (i j : Fin n) :
    ((rectangularRep (m := n) (n := n) h).compile ⟨s, hlen⟩).W i j =
        ((FullWidth.weightSymbolRep h).compile ⟨s, hlen⟩).W i j ∧
      ((rectangularRep (m := n) (n := n) h).compile ⟨s, hlen⟩).b j =
        ((FullWidth.weightSymbolRep h).compile ⟨s, hlen⟩).b j
proof:
by
  refine ⟨?_, ?_⟩
  · show (layerOfListRect (m := n) (n := n) s).W i j =
      (FullWidth.layerOfListFull (n := n) s).W i j
    exact (layerOfListRect_eq_full_width s i j).1
  · show (layerOfListRect (m := n) (n := n) s).b j =
      (FullWidth.layerOfListFull (n := n) s).b j
    exact (layerOfListRect_eq_full_width s i j).2

name: any_shape_is_exactly_representable
doc:
**任意形状的层都可精确往返**——本节的主结论，一条可引用的陈述。

它说的是：对**任意** `m`、`n`（`n > 0`），存在一个 `Representation`，其 `compile` 是本节
的满宽编码器，且 `roundtrip` 已证。**方阵只是 `m = n` 的特例。**
stmt:
theorem any_shape_is_exactly_representable :
    ∀ (m n : ℕ) (_hn : 0 < n),
      ∃ R : Representation { s : List ℝ // s.length = m * n + n }
              (LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)),
        (∀ p, R.compile p = layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) p.val) ∧
        (∀ p, R.extract (R.compile p) = p)
proof:
fun m n hn =>
    ⟨rectangularRep (m := m) (n := n) hn, fun _ => rfl,
     rectangularRep_roundtrip (m := m) (n := n) hn⟩

end Lattice.Lift.Rectangular

name: layerOfListRect
doc: **长方阵的满宽编码器**：`W i j` 读 `s[i*n + j]`，`b j` 读 `s[m*n + j]`。
stmt:
noncomputable def layerOfListRect (s : List ℝ) : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n) where
  W
proof:
fun i j => s.getD (i.val * n + j.val) 0
  b := fun j => s.getD (m * n + j.val) 0

name: layerOfListRect_W
doc: **读回系数**：位置就是定义里写的那个。
stmt:
theorem layerOfListRect_W (s : List ℝ) (i : Fin m) (j : Fin n) :
    (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).W i j = s.getD (i.val * n + j.val) 0

name: layerOfListRect_b
doc: **读回偏置**：在 `m*n` 之后。
stmt:
theorem layerOfListRect_b (s : List ℝ) (j : Fin n) :
    (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).b j = s.getD (m * n + j.val) 0

name: listOfLayerRect
doc:
**逆**：系数按除法索引读回，然后偏置。

`Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hn` 把 `k/n < m` 归结为 `0 < n ∧ k < m*n`——后者正是 `k.isLt`。
**不能用 `Nat.div_lt_of_lt_mul`**：它要求除数在前，而 `k` 的类型是 `Fin (m*n)`，重排会破坏 `k.isLt`。
stmt: noncomputable def listOfLayerRect (hn : 0 < n) (L : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)) : List ℝ
proof:
(List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (m * n) =>
      L.W ⟨k.val / n, (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hn).mpr k.isLt⟩ ⟨k.val % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩)) ++
    (List.ofFn (fun j : Fin n => L.b j))

name: listOfLayerRect_length
doc: **逆的长度是 `m*n + n`。**
stmt:
theorem listOfLayerRect_length (hn : 0 < n) (L : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)) :
    (listOfLayerRect hn L).length = m * n + n
proof:
by
  unfold listOfLayerRect
  rw [List.length_append, List.length_ofFn, List.length_ofFn]

name: roundtrip_rect
doc:
**往返**：`listOfLayerRect` 是 `layerOfListRect` 的逆（长度匹配时）。

证明结构与方阵版相同：`List.ext_getElem` + `List.getElem_append_left`/`_right`
（它们的下标证明是**隐式**的，所以 `ext` 提供的证明自然匹配），
系数半归约成 `(k/n)*n + k%n = k`，偏置半归约成 `m*n + (k - m*n) = k`。
stmt:
theorem roundtrip_rect (hn : 0 < n) (s : List ℝ) (hlen : s.length = m * n + n) :
    listOfLayerRect hn (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s) = s
proof:
by
  apply List.ext_getElem
  · rw [listOfLayerRect_length, hlen]
  · intro k h1 h2
    unfold listOfLayerRect
    rcases Nat.lt_or_ge k (m * n) with hk | hk
    · rw [List.getElem_append_left (i := k) (as := List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (m * n) =>
          (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).W
            ⟨k.val / n, (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hn).mpr k.isLt⟩ ⟨k.val % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩))
        (by rw [List.length_ofFn]; exact hk)]
      rw [List.getElem_ofFn, layerOfListRect_W]
      rw [Nat.mul_comm (k / n) n, Nat.div_add_mod k n]
      exact List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h2
    · rw [List.getElem_append_right (i := k) (as := List.ofFn (fun k : Fin (m * n) =>
          (layerOfListRect (m := m) (n := n) s).W
            ⟨k.val / n, (Nat.div_lt_iff_lt_mul hn).mpr k.isLt⟩ ⟨k.val % n, Nat.mod_lt _ hn⟩))
        (by rw [List.length_ofFn]; exact hk)]
      rw [List.getElem_ofFn, layerOfListRect_b]
      simp only [Fin.val_mk]
      rw [List.length_ofFn, Nat.add_sub_cancel' hk]
      exact List.getD_eq_getElem _ _ h2

name: layerOfListRect_eq_full_width
doc:
**`m = n` 时退化为方阵版**：这是「推广而非平行」的机器检查形式。

方阵版 `layerOfListFull` 的 `W` 与 `b` 与本节的 `layerOfListRect` 在 `m = n` 时逐字相同。
stmt:
theorem layerOfListRect_eq_full_width {n : ℕ} (s : List ℝ) (i j : Fin n) :
    (layerOfListRect (m := n) (n := n) s).W i j =
        (FullWidth.layerOfListFull (n := n) s).W i j ∧
      (layerOfListRect (m := n) (n := n) s).b j =
        (FullWidth.layerOfListFull (n := n) s).b j

name: toParams
doc: **`AffineLayer n` → `LayerParams n n`**。
stmt:
def toParams {n : Type} (p : AffineLayer n) : LayerParams n n where
  W

name: ofParams
doc: **`LayerParams n n` → `AffineLayer n`**。
stmt:
def ofParams {n : Type} (q : LayerParams n n) : AffineLayer n where
  W

name: toParams_ofParams
doc: **往返**：两族在方阵情形下是同一个东西。
stmt: theorem toParams_ofParams {n : Type} (q : LayerParams n n) : toParams (ofParams q) = q

name: ofParams_toParams
doc: **往返（另一方向）**。
stmt: theorem ofParams_toParams {n : Type} (p : AffineLayer n) : ofParams (toParams p) = p

name: toParams_injective
doc: **单射**：转换不丢信息。
stmt: theorem toParams_injective {n : Type} : Function.Injective (@toParams n)
proof:
by
  intro p q h
  have := ofParams_toParams p ▸ ofParams_toParams q ▸ congrArg ofParams h
  simpa using this

name: act_toParams
doc:
**函子性**：`AffineLayer` 与 `LayerParams` 的前向传播一致。

**这是「换一族表示不改变行为」的确切内容**——
不是范畴论的口号，而是 `affineAct p x = LayerParams.act (toParams p) x`。
stmt:
theorem act_toParams {n : Type} [Fintype n] (p : AffineLayer n) (x : n → ℝ) (j : n) :
    affineAct p x j = (∑ i, (toParams p).W i j * x i) + (toParams p).b j

name: toMLayer
doc: **`LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)` → `MLayer m n`**。
stmt:
def toMLayer {m n : ℕ} (q : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)) : MLayer m n where
  W
proof:
fun i j => q.W i j
  b := q.b

name: ofMLayer
doc: **`MLayer m n` → `LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)`**。
stmt:
def ofMLayer {m n : ℕ} (l : MLayer m n) : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n) where
  W
proof:
fun i j => l.W i j
  b := l.b

name: toMLayer_ofMLayer
stmt: theorem toMLayer_ofMLayer {m n : ℕ} (l : MLayer m n) : toMLayer (ofMLayer l) = l

name: ofMLayer_toMLayer
doc: **往返（另一方向）**。
stmt:
theorem ofMLayer_toMLayer {m n : ℕ} (q : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)) :
    ofMLayer (toMLayer q) = q

name: three_families_connected
doc:
**三族连通**：`AffineLayer n` 与 `LayerParams n n` 同构，
且 `LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n)` 与 `MLayer m n` 同构。

⇒ **权重侧不是一族，是三族且可互转。** 这是「链 → 谱系」的第一步。
stmt:
theorem three_families_connected {n m : ℕ} :
    (∀ q : LayerParams (Fin n) (Fin n), toParams (ofParams q) = q) ∧
    (∀ p : AffineLayer (Fin n), ofParams (toParams p) = p) ∧
    (∀ l : MLayer m n, toMLayer (ofMLayer l) = l) ∧
    (∀ q : LayerParams (Fin m) (Fin n), ofMLayer (toMLayer q) = q)
proof:
⟨fun q => toParams_ofParams q,
   fun p => ofParams_toParams p,
   fun l => toMLayer_ofMLayer l,
   fun q => ofMLayer_toMLayer q⟩

end RepresentationFamilies

end Lattice.Lift
